about: What this person told voters in each campaign since 2016: their campaign website as saved by the Wayback Machine just before election day (the homepage and the pages about where they stand), as text, and their campaign-season Bluesky and Threads posts. From scripts/collect-campaign-text.mjs; the promises in it are found by step 2.
name: Tammy Duckworth

pages.title: Tammy Duckworth for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
Soldier. Senator. Mother.
Want to be first to get updates from our campaign?
*By submitting your cell phone number you are agreeing to receive periodic text messages from Tammy for Illinois. Message and data rates may apply. Text HELP for more information. Text STOP to stop receiving messages. See our privacy policy at tammyduckworth.com/privacy-policy/.
## A tireless advocate for Illinois
Tammy Duckworth is a champion for working families, civil rights, environmental justice as well as all of our Veterans and military families. From growing up working to pull her family out of poverty to serving our nation in uniform, Tammy’s life shapes her work in the Senate.
With your help, we will re-elect Tammy Duckworth and keep the Senate blue!
or chip in another amount

posts.text:
Trump tried to stop Americans from doing what he’s already done twice this year: vote by mail. He failed.

Voting by mail is safe, secure and here to stay 🇺🇸

I pushed for independent oversight. Now, for the first time, we have an official glimpse at the damage—and it’s still an underestimate.

Resources drained. Munitions depleted. Diplomacy wrecked. Troops exhausted.

The American people deserve the full truth.

www.washingtonpost.com/politics/202...

It’s National Voter Registration Day, Illinois!
 
Take a moment to make sure you are registered and have a plan to vote.

Vote.gov

Trump already enacted the largest Medicaid cut in history. Now hospitals warn his latest proposed rules could cut hundreds of billions more.
 
Whether you rely on Medicaid or not, a closed hospital can’t care for anyone.

When our military has needed more recruits, immigrants have always answered the call to serve.

Deporting their family members is a slap in the face to these servicemembers who are willing to defend our country in uniform.

Let's be clear: $38 billion is still a gross underestimate of what Trump's illegal war has actually cost. And they're expected to burn through $2 to $3 billion every month it drags on.

Closed door briefings won't cut it. Congress must hold a public hearing immediately.

Ectopic pregnancy deaths have nearly doubled in post-Roe America. The rates are even worse in states with abortion bans. 

When we warned them women would die, they didn't listen. 

This was preventable.
Happy birthday to the brave men and women of the United States Air Force who defend our skies. Aim High!

On National POW/MIA Recognition Day, we honor the unwavering dedication of our servicemembers who’ve been held as prisoners as war. We honor those who remain unaccounted for and we will continue searching for them. We will never forget their sacrifices and service to our country.

22 of our servicemembers have been killed in Trump's illegal war. Not 18 like we were told. The Pentagon hid four more heroes' deaths from us for months.

Congress cannot let them get away with this.

I wrote a bill we can pass to stop this egregious playbook immediately.
Wishing all who are observing Yom Kippur this evening a fulfilling, meaningful and peaceful fast.   G’mar Chatimah Tovah.

This is not about national security. This is about using our troops to justify a vanity project that aviation experts, Veterans and the American people do not want.

Pathetic.

www.nytimes.com/2026/09/20/u...

The “most transparent Administration in history” is kicking reporters out of the White House ahead of an election because Trump doesn’t like their coverage.
 
This is straight out of the authoritarian playbook.

apnews.com/article/trum...?

Looking stronger and healthier every day, @govpritzker.illinois.gov!

Life-changing care shouldn’t be out of reach for anyone. Together, we’ll keep pushing to lower costs so every Illinoisan can access the medication they need to succeed.

Trump says the only guardrail that AI needs is him as President.

That’s a bold pitch from the guy whose wallets get fatter even as gas, grocery and electricity costs soar from his illegal war.

If his leadership isn’t working for the American people, why would it work for AI?

At least 22 servicemembers killed.
Hundreds of U.S. bases damaged.
Over $45 billion spent and counting. 

How much more will the American people pay for Trump's failure?
Trump should be honoring the families of our servicemembers, not rounding them up for deportation. Enough is enough.

ICE remains out of control. In Evanston, Trump’s maskless agents slammed an innocent man to the ground before realizing they had the wrong guy.

Republicans silence speaks volumes.

The human toll of this war is more than any of us could've imagined. Eight servicemembers across the USS Lincoln Strike Force attempted to take their own lives—and we wouldn't have known unless we pushed for answers.
 
It's long past time for a public hearing on Trump's war.

NEWS: I’m calling on FAA Administrator Bedford and Defense Secretary Hegseth to immediately reject Donald Trump’s plan to turn his golden vanity arch into a military complex.

This plan is as dangerous as it is ridiculous. Full stop.

On Gold Star Mother’s and Family Day, we honor the families of the servicemembers we’ve lost and the legacy of these heroes that they will carry forever. Our nation owes immeasurable debt to our Gold Star Families and their sacrifices.

On Gold Star Mother’s and Family Day, we honor the families of the servicemembers we’ve lost and the legacy of these heroes that they will carry forever. Our nation owes immeasurable debt to our Gold Star Families and their sacrifices.

According to a new survey, Americans feel worse about the economy than during either the COVID-19 pandemic or the 2008 financial crisis.

Meanwhile, Trump is fighting illegal wars and building golden ballrooms.

Time for action on groceries, health care and housing. Not vanity.

Pilots and air traffic controllers operate under immense stress—and yet, they are far too often penalized for seeking the mental health care they need.
 
The Senate just passed two bipartisan bills led by myself and Sen. John Hoeven to help fix that.

www.reuters.com/business/hea...

ICE is showing up at hospitals, schools and airports—terrorizing families to go after people who have never even been charged with a crime.

Enough. It’s past time for a complete overhaul of Trump’s ICE, DHS and Border Patrol.

No one experiencing an allergic reaction should have to hope someone on board has an Epi-Pen to spare. All flights should just have the life-saving treatment you need.
 
The FAA must reverse course and require epinephrine in every emergency medical kit on every flight. 

Lives could depend on it.

For 50 years, the Hyde amendment has blocked abortion care for millions of women, especially women of color and those most in need.

It’s past time Congress passes my EACH Act to finally end the Hyde amendment.

Abortion care is health care. Period.

Arlington Cemetery is hallowed ground. A final resting place for our fallen heroes who were brave enough to serve.

How dare this five-time draft dodger dishonor them by trying to erect a monument to his own vanity?

Veterans will not let him get away with it.

NEWS: Today, I led a group of 20 bipartisan lawmakers calling on the FAA to guarantee that emergency medical kits require epinephrine on every flight.

Because if you have an allergic reaction 35,000 feet in the air, you should trust there's the medication you need on board.
Trump's arch is not about national security. It’s about his own personal insecurities.

Trump promised to cut your energy prices in half within 12 months.

Today, a gallon of regular in Illinois costs $4.66. One year ago, it cost $3.31. That’s $20 more to fill a 15-gallon tank.

Trump broke his promise to cut costs and avoid war. Now you’re stuck holding the bill.

Declaring war on Chicago wasn't normal.

Inciting treason and encouraging an active adversary to bomb Southern California isn't normal.

Who's next? A President hellbent on going after "the enemy within" is a threat to us all.

Three years ago, Hamas committed the deadliest atrocity against the Jewish people since the Holocaust. Today, we remember every hostage taken, every life stolen, every family forever changed and the millions of innocent Palestinians in Gaza still suffering.

10 years ago, the Survivors’ Bill of Rights Act was signed into law —affirming that all survivors of sexual assault deserve dignity, respect and justice.

Today, as much as ever, we must listen to survivors, protect their rights and ensure no one who comes forward is ever ignored.

Hegseth likes to say “war is hell.” But keeping our troops at sea for over 300 days with dwindling supplies was a level of hell this Administration could’ve avoided, but didn’t.

The toll this war has had on our troops and their families is too high. We need a public hearing now.

Donald Trump wants to handpick the lawyers defending children from his own deportation machine.
 
Absolutely not.

www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news...

Few people are as synonymous with Chicago as Mike Ditka.

Illinois will miss him dearly, but his legacy will never be forgotten. My heart goes out to his family and everyone who loved Da Coach.

Trump’s illegal war and disastrous policies are sending fuel costs soaring and leaving farmers behind.

Governor Pritzker is taking action to help bring costs down and deliver relief.

I refuse to let Donald Trump trample the rights of children seeking safety in our country.

The Trump Administration must abandon its heinous plan and restore access to independent lawyers for immigrant kids facing deportation.

Putin told Iran the locations of our warships.

Today, Trump rewarded him by lifting sanctions and allowing American dollars to fuel Russia’s war machine.

Our troops are in harm’s way, and the President cut a deal with the adversary putting a target on their backs.
Happy 251st birthday, U.S. Navy! ⚓️🇺🇸

You don't have to drive a diesel truck to feel the squeeze of Trump's illegal war.
 
Diesel prices are up more than 75%, driving up the cost of growing your food, shipping your groceries and delivering everyday goods.
 
Americans can’t go on like this. It’s time to end the war.

Costs are too high. Wages are too low. And Trump is focused on raising up monuments and building ballrooms to stroke his own ego.

It's a "Golden Age" for no one but him.

This is peak corruption.

Under the Trump Administration, you get the bill for the President's illegal war. The rich get richer. And nobody gets held accountable.

www.bloomberg.com/news/feature...

Buying a home was already too expensive, and now we’re seeing the highest mortgage rates in nearly 3 years.

Higher gas prices. Higher grocery bills. Higher mortgage payments.

Americans just can't afford the cost of Trump's war.

Absolutely horrifying. My heart is with the Hindu community in the wake of this news, and I'm grateful to the heroes at the Mount Prospect and Palatine Police Departments who helped prevent an unthinkable tragedy.

White supremacy and hate have no place in our nation.
www.cbsnews.com/chicago/news...

3 kids and one other have been killed at an elementary school in Oregon. Kids should be picking out Halloween costumes—not hiding from a gunman.

Our kids deserve leaders who will do everything they can to keep them safe from gun violence.

Inaction is not an option.
AI is advancing at breakneck speed. Americans deserve safeguards that protect their jobs, their privacy and their pocketbook. Not voluntary "promises" and tech companies writing their own rules.

$50 billion in rural health care funding after gutting $1 trillion from health care is like putting a band-aid on a bullet hole.

Democrats fought for families. Republicans fought for billionaire tax cuts.
Reminder: it is illegal to send militarized federal agents to intimidate voters at our polling places.

The cost of food, clothes, appliances and other everyday items were actually coming down before Trump’s tariff chaos.

End. The. Wars. From the illegal war in Iran to the trade war with Canada, enough is enough.

It’s a clear conflict of interest for the Trump Administration to have their own lawyers represent immigrant children against their own deportation machine.

We have two demands for Secretary Kennedy:

(1) Drop this absurd plan
(2) Restore independent legal counsel

Now.

Behind closed doors, the DoD has made a bad habit of classifying the minimal details they choose to tell Congress. Why?

Because if it's classified, we can't talk about it and they can go on hiding the cost of this war from the public.

No more. Americans deserve to know.
They're right. It's the Golden Age of Grift.

Their cruelty has no bottom.

Why should Americans volunteer to sacrifice for our country if our government won't protect their loved ones from being torn apart back home?

This isn’t helping recruitment, retention or morale. And it sure isn’t making any of us safer.

Wages are down. Inflation is up. Over 5 million people have lost SNAP benefits. And we’ve had more days in 2026 where gas was above $4 a gallon than any other year.

While Trump is billions richer.

There's a clear "winner" in Trump's America.

And it isn't you.
Anyone who thought a public execution was a good idea is unfit to hold positions of leadership in the United States of America. Hegseth needs to go.

This is horrifying. They're sending armed agents door to door, traumatizing children and demanding proof of citizenship. And next, they'll be at our polling places.
 
The lengths Trump will go to cling to power are shocking and un-American.

This is horrifying. They're sending armed agents door to door, traumatizing children and demanding proof of citizenship. And next, they'll be at our polling places.
 
The lengths Trump will go to cling to power are shocking and un-American.

Trump slashed 30% of the CDC’s workforce, weakening our ability to detect outbreaks, fight disease and protect American lives.
 
You can't make America healthy again by firing the people who protect our public health.

Americans paid an extra $310 for groceries in Trump’s first year in office alone. Now ground beef is over $7 a pound and coffee is topping $9.

Families can't afford Trump's broken promises.

The Governor said no. The Supreme Court said no.
 
And the last time he tried to send the National Guard in, it cost taxpayers $21 million.
 
Never again. Trump is not a king.

At least 52 maternity wards have closed since Trump signed off on the largest Medicaid cut in history.
 
No mother should have to travel farther for lifesaving treatment because Republicans prioritized tax breaks for billionaires over healthcare.
 
They should be ashamed.

So when you’re paying hundreds more for gas per month, remember:

The President doesn’t give a damn.

NEWS: A new report reveals Trump’s personal oil and gas holdings have nearly doubled in value, now worth as much as $81.6 million compared to as much as $46 million last year.
 
The President is profiting off Americans' suffering. And he couldn't be prouder.

Trump admitted he blocked energy funding to punish blue states he lost in 2024, including $586 million for Illinois.

Courts ruled it illegal. He's still blocking the money.

Bipartisan permitting reform won't work if Trump ignores the law. He must reinstate the grants first.

Dolores Huerta was a true force for good. She taught us all what it means to fight for the voiceless, ensuring generations of workers have better wages, safer working conditions and a fairer shot at the American Dream.
 
Her legacy will inspire us forever. ¡Sí, se puede!

Officially 8 months into an illegal war the President said would only take a few weeks.
 
22 servicemembers killed.
Hundreds more wounded.
Munitions stockpile drained.
Military bases damaged.
Diplomatic footprint eroded.
$47+ billion spent.
 
Republican inaction is unforgivable.
Americans deserve a government of, by and for the people. Trump is leading a presidency of, by and for him and the billionaire class.

Putin’s diesel is officially on its way over.

America is funding a brutal dictator who is a friend to Iran and enemy of Ukraine. Courtesy of Donald Trump.

Donald Trump is the smallest man with an ego so paper-thin that he’s abusing his power to meddle with the election in Alaska.

Because he knows he’s going to lose.

Feliz Día de los Muertos to everyone celebrating in Illinois and beyond! During this holiday, we honor the loved ones who live on in our hearts and the traditions that keep their memories alive.

May this time be full of colorful ofrendas, beautiful marigolds and plenty of pan de muerto 🌼💀

Donald Trump's dangerously low Halloween flyover was a reckless vanity stunt.

He terrified local residents, disrupted flights and risked aviation safety to parade around his new Qatar-gifted toy—wasting taxpayer dollars, even as prices keep soaring.

I'm demanding answers.

Exercising your right to vote is one of the highest, most sacred responsibilities we have as American citizens.

Get out there and vote for the future you want.
